info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-fulfillment-dotnet-api-Get Api Session By Session Id-v1-spec
info.description: The Session Retrieval API allows clients to access detailed information about specific user sessions using a unique session identifier. This endpoint enables applications to retrieve session data, which can be utilized for auditing, monitoring, or user experience enhancements. Typical consumers include client applications and monitoring tools that need to display or analyze session-related metrics. By providing quick access to session information, this API supports effective session management and user engagement strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific session by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about a specific session using its unique identifier. It provides insights into session attributes, user participation, and other relevant details, making it easier to manage and understand session data.

200.description: Request completed successfully; session details retrieved.

GetApiSessionBySessionIdResponse_200.title: Session Operation Response

id.description: The unique identifier for the session.

endpoint.description: The endpoint being accessed during the session.

protocol.description: The protocol used for the session (e.g., HTTP, HTTPS).

method.description: The HTTP method used for the session (e.g., GET, POST).

auth.description: The authentication method used for the session (e.g., Bearer Token, Basic Authentication).

size.description: The size of the response data in bytes.

received_bytes.description: The number of bytes received in the response.

timestamp.description: The timestamp indicating when the session was created or accessed.

data.description: Additional data or details related to the session.

GetApiSessionBySessionIdResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful GET operation retrieving session details.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme utilizing a bearer token for secure access to the API. Clients must include the token in the Authorization header of their requests.
